plabdab.name: PLAbDab
plabdab.license: See upstream project/data terms; code repository is BSD-3-Clause
plabdab.citation: Abanades et al. Nucleic Acids Research 52(D1), 2024, D545-D551
plabdab.notes: Targets are literature-derived mentions and should not be interpreted as direct binding measurements. Semicolon-delimited co-mentions are indexed as separate targets, never aliases.

therasabdab.name: Thera-SAbDab
therasabdab.license: See OPIG/SAbDab terms and source attribution
therasabdab.citation: Raybould et al. Nucleic Acids Research 48(D1), 2020
therasabdab.notes: WHO-recognised therapeutic antibody records with public sequences.

covabdab.name: CoV-AbDab
covabdab.notes: Coronavirus-binding antibody and nanobody data. The importer discovers the current CSV link from the upstream page at build time.

poxabdab.name: Pox-AbDab
poxabdab.citation: Capel et al. Pox-AbDab: the Orthopoxvirus Antibody Database, 2025 preprint
poxabdab.notes: Orthopoxvirus binding, neutralisation and protection annotations.

iedb.name: IEDB BCR
iedb.citation: Immune Epitope Database and Analysis Resource (IEDB), BCR export
iedb.notes: IEDB BCR sequence records. Calculated and curated chain annotations remain distinct; source nucleotide sequences retain full-length BCR scope. Measurements join bcr_search receptor groups to bcell_export assays only through explicit IDs; target assertions require an explicit source-molecule or molecule-parent IRI.

abcd.name: ABCD
abcd.notes: Adapter intentionally disabled until a legitimate bulk data route is arranged.

naturalantibody_asd.name: Antigen-Specific Antibody Database (ASD)
naturalantibody_asd.license: Non-commercial research access; not redistributed by default
naturalantibody_asd.notes: Optional local integration point; excluded from the public GitHub Pages build.
